# Function: generateCacheKey()

> **generateCacheKey**(`ignoreKeys`, `namespace`, ...`args`): `Promise`\<`string`\>

Defined in: [cache.ts:172](https://github.com/md2docx/md2docx/blob/main/packages/cache/src/cache.ts#L172)

Generates a consistent 64-bit hash key for caching based on input arguments.

- Serializes objects using `stableSerialize`
- Combines all arguments into a single stable string

## Parameters

### ignoreKeys

`string`[]

Keys to exclude from object serialization

### namespace

`string`

### args

...`unknown`[]

Values to base the cache key on (objects, arrays, or primitives)

## Returns

`Promise`\<`string`\>

A stable 64-bit hash string
